description: This file defines configuration types, default settings, and functions for resolving, validating, and merging configuration options for Playwright's MCP (Multi-Channel Protocol) setup. It includes CLI and environment variable parsing, file loading, and validation logic.

methods.name: fileExistsAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: resolveConfig
methods.description: Merges default configuration with provided config to produce a full configuration object.

methods.name: resolveCLIConfig
methods.description: Resolves configuration from CLI options, environment variables, and config files, merging them into a full config.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the given full configuration, checking for file existence and platform-specific options.

methods.name: configFromCLIOptions
methods.description: Creates a configuration object from CLI options.

methods.name: configFromEnv
methods.description: Creates a configuration object from environment variables.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file, supporting JSON and INI formats.

methods.name: pickDefined
methods.description: Filters out undefined properties from an object.

methods.name: mergeConfig
methods.description: Merges two configuration objects, with overrides taking precedence.

methods.name: semicolonSeparatedList
methods.description: Splits a string by semicolons into a list of strings.

methods.name: commaSeparatedList
methods.description: Splits a string by commas into a list of strings.

methods.name: dotenvFileLoader
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a dotenv file.

methods.name: numberParser
methods.description: Parses a string into a number.

methods.name: resolutionParser
methods.description: Parses resolution strings like '800x600' or '800,600' into width and height.

methods.name: headerParser
methods.description: Parses header strings into key-value pairs.

methods.name: enumParser
methods.description: Validates that a string value is within a set of allowed options.

methods.name: envToBoolean
methods.description: Converts environment variable string to boolean.

methods.name: envToString
methods.description: Converts environment variable string to trimmed string.
